==Biography==
Gediminas is from Siauliai, Lithuania.  He used to play Midlane but changed to Jungle to better suit his team.

== Trivia ==
* Has a BA in Economics and worked as an economist before chasing his dream of becoming a pro player.
* His nickname means "To Land on the Moon" in French.
* Known for aggressive counterjungling.
